brief.headline: Push for ₹0.70–0.80/pc on standard caps (market typical is ₹0.85–0.95) and tighten payment to 15 days to free up ₹1.82 L cash

priceAsk.summary: Target ₹0.70–0.80/pc on high-volume caps, down from market typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc
priceAsk.target: ₹0.70–0.80/pc (the lower end of the ₹0.65–0.80 headroom band at higher volume)
priceAsk.basis: Market research shows a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap asks ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec — we buy steady volume, so we should land in that lower band

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days after receipt to 15 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Tightening payment by 15 days frees up ₹1.82 L cash for us

brief.financialLeverage: Rachana Plastics publishes no financials, so we can't see their cash position or how big we are to them. Our annual spend is ₹44.37 L — meaningful but not huge. Without their numbers, we lean on our own data and the fact that we have five strong alternates lined up (including Manjushree Technopack, India's largest rigid-plastic converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue). That second-source threat is real, so we can push firmly on price and terms, but we keep it professional — no need to squeeze a supplier we can't see inside.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, B health score 65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader for pails, containers, pharma; strong and profitable — a robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ) — pan-India maker; medium confidence from public research

risks: Rachana's financials aren't public, so we're flying blind on their cash and stability — watch for any signs of delivery trouble or quality slip that might hint at stress
Tightening payment to 15 days may push back hard if their cash is already tight; be ready to trade it explicitly for a price cut
The market-ask data is for a generic 28 mm cap — if our spec is tighter (colour, certification, custom mould), the headroom shrinks and they'll argue ₹0.85–0.95 is fair
We have good alternates on paper, but none are qualified yet — don't bluff a switch we can't execute this quarter; frame it as 'we're lining up a second source' not 'we're walking tomorrow'
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to talk about bringing our cap price down toward ₹0.70–0.80 — the market shows that range is fair at our volume — and tightening payment to 15 days to help both of us move faster.
